display_name: 时间覆盖×分支内非线性：四条件匹配特征实验
description: 四个匹配时序条件＋固定原始基线；15row，12新scratch50＋3同seed旧基线。旧TIME_MS50不混入匹配统计，因为新增初始化曾消耗native随机流。本轮只用默认分类头joint训练，不另训头。
authorization: Current user pasted temporal multiscale review requests coverage x within-branch nonlinearity four-condition experiment with default jointly trained head only; earlier goal authorizes <=50/model and three seeds, clean84% research goal.

checkpoint.initialization: All four new arms independent scratch50, same class-independent block weight draws seed+48213 in CPU fork_rng. Historical fixed baseline is comparison only, never inherited.

checkpoint.baseline_provenance: previous full audit VERIFIED: exact role IDs, source RX1/3/4/6/8 x3days, L6300 U56700 hidden V27000,11100optimizer/EMA updates, no target fit or selection

execution.gpu_policy: max3 total experiment processes/GPU including otherowners, >=12000MB free, preserve healthy workloads
execution.stop_rule: First seed five rows; all four new arms must pass final LCE<=0.5, default source V mean drop<=1pp and worstRX drop<=2pp vs fixed BASE_REF before seeds02/03. No target feedback or candidate ranking. Technical legality/roles/U truth/collision/nonfinite/incomplete prediction failure stops new dispatch, preserves active healthy rows, no autoretry. Scientific screen failure preserves first-seed results and does not expand seeds.

notes: Current user instruction prohibits separately trained heads, supersedes diagnostic refit permission for this experiment.
Only clean Phase1 comparison, no Phase2, no satellite deployment claim.
Compact t3 kernel5 is longer than original native kernel3; compact means relative to long condition, not exact original footprint.
GN gives samplewise global temporal dependence; local convolution envelopes are not measured effective receptive fields.
Default W and all non-time initial states exact matched; changed operators intentionally have different initial functions.
Firstsource gates fixed before target; no selective seed reruns or target-driven parent selection.
Old TIME_MS50 historical and new LONG_LINEAR must be reported separately despite same topology.
No head fitting, no extra loss, no PA/frequency/reference/Sinc changes; pure export retains all feature norms/gains.
Native RNG restored after added block initialization; forwards have same Dropout number/shapes, SiLU and dilation consume no RNG. No bitwise GPU-training trajectory promise.
Historical source weight-only kernel audit legal and no IQ/truth read; scale-removal consumes legal source V, no state update.
Future post-fusion SiLU control/layer allocation/hierarchical combinations deferred; no target scores select them.
local_verification: PASS including actual CPU and CUDA RNG preservation for4arms, native move_batch/threshold/temporal masks identical, hiddenTX rejection, actual parameter updates/features/W independence, noquery negatives

independent_review.scope: one P0/P1 initial review and one issue-specific re-review
fixed_issues: CPU-only initialization avoids CUDA RNG reset
independent_review.reviewed_extra: historical TIME source-only frozen diagnostic interface and source-stage closure
